banks.name: Diagnostic bank
banks.purpose: Builds each student's baseline competency profile before the 28-week programme starts, per §13.1 step 1 ("Diagnostic baseline -> profil kompetensi per siswa"), by testing exactly the five §14.1 diagnostic areas: C++, logika, matematika, complexity, dan problem solving. Kept separate from weekly/checkpoint/stage-facing banks per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "rubric" (DERIVED): a "profil kompetensi" is a graded profile across five areas, not a single pass/fail signal, so each area is scored against named mastery criteria rather than accept/reject.

banks.name: Weekly bank
banks.purpose: Supplies the curated per-week practice problems §13.1 step 2 draws on ("Weekly plan -> latihan berdasarkan gap dan target tahap seleksi"), sized against §1.3's "Soal terkurasi" baseline (umumnya 8-12/minggu) and required by §14.1 to exist for every week with at least one alternative per topic. Kept separate from diagnostic/checkpoint/stage-facing banks per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "binary" (DERIVED): ordinary curated practice problems are graded by a plain judge accept/reject verdict, the base signal the §6.2 A/B/C/D problem-completion codes are themselves built on.

banks.name: Checkpoint bank
banks.purpose: Supplies the mastery evaluation given at the end of every 4-week block, per §1.3's Checkpoint row ("Akhir setiap 4 minggu") and the §4.1 phase-gate evidence a learner must show before proceeding. Kept separate from diagnostic/weekly/stage-facing banks per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "rubric", directly stated by §1.3's own Checkpoint note: "Gunakan rubrik mastery, bukan ranking saja" (use a mastery rubric, not just ranking).

banks.name: OSN-K style bank
banks.purpose: Rehearses the OSN-K contest format and dominant competencies from §2.2 (computational thinking, modeling, logika, membaca algoritma C++, tracing, kompleksitas) via §2.2's OSN-K practice model (worksheet analitis, dry-run, Bebras-style, short coding, quiz kompleksitas). Kept separate from the other five bank kinds per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "binary" (DERIVED): §2.2's OSN-K practice-model items are objective, single-correct-answer items (worksheet, dry-run, quiz), unlike OSN-P, whose row states "Partial scoring" outright and OSN-K's does not.

banks.name: OSN-P style bank
banks.purpose: Rehearses the OSN-P case-study contest format from §2.2 (5-8 studi kasus/3 jam, each with 3 soal pemahaman + 1 soal pemrograman with easy/hard subtasks) via §2.2's OSN-P practice model, which states "Partial scoring, baseline -> optimized solution, contest 3 jam, postmortem" outright. Kept separate from the other five bank kinds per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "partial", directly stated by §2.2's OSN-P practice-model cell -- not derived, the one bank kind whose scoring model the source names outright.

banks.name: National mixed bank
banks.purpose: Rehearses OSN Nasional's mixed-topic, full-integration format from §2.2 ("Integrasi materi, implementasi presisi, daya tahan contest, strategi poin", practice model "Mixed-topic contest, arsip nasional, stress testing, editorial review terbatas"), combining OSN-K-style analytical items with OSN-P-style partial-credit programming cases. Kept separate from the other five bank kinds per §13's Assessment Bank row. scoringModel is "partial" (DERIVED): §2.2 names "strategi poin" (a points strategy) among OSN Nasional's dominant competencies, implying partial-credit point accumulation rather than a binary pass/fail, and the format mixes in OSN-P-style programming cases that are themselves partially scored.
